thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: production embeddings-worker error rate > 8% for the last 3m in eu-west-1. Paging @Sam (oncall) and @Priya (SRE).
Sam (oncall): acknowledged. jumping on call in ~2m. where is the impact window? any customers flagged? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya (Support): seeing a spike in ticket volume — some customers reporting failed indexing jobs. Example ticket: ‘embedding timeout 504’. Not wide-reaching yet but several high-value customers in EU.
Priya (SRE): looking at logs now. initial hypothesis: KV cache misses + a recent rolling deploy to embeddings-workers v2.3.4. rolling back one node to v2.3.3 for testing.
Sam (oncall): @Priya good. quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce concurrency on workers 2) revert release if rollback shows improvement 3) enable fallback model-route to a smaller embedding model for high-priority customers.
Zoe (CS): drafting a customer-safe reply for Zendesk/Intercom. Will post template here for review before sending.
Maya (Support): also need a short statuspage blurb and internal summary for execs. Keep it concise: what happened, who is affected, mitigation, ETA.
Priya (SRE): measurement: error rate dropped to 3.1% on rollback test node within 45s. that's promising. continuing rollback across the cluster.
Sam (oncall): good. start sending customer ACKs for impacted customers. Use the macro below. Mark tickets with tag `incident-1965` and route to CS-high.
Maya (Support): macro draft for Zendesk (please keep neutral, no root cause yet):
```
[ACK_INCIDENT_1965]
Hi {{customer_name}},
Thanks for flagging this — we’re aware of increased embedding errors in eu-west-1 and our on-call team is investigating. We may have intermittent failures for indexing/generation jobs.
What we’re doing: rolling back a recent service change and enabling a fallback model to reduce errors.
ETA: initial mitigation in progress; we’ll follow up within 30 minutes with an update.
If you’re seeing urgent failures affecting production, reply here with the job IDs and we’ll prioritize escalation.
Thanks for your patience,
— Maya, Redwood Support
```
Priya (SRE): Intercom short reply (for in-app):
```
We’re investigating intermittent embedding failures in eu-west-1. Mitigation underway — some requests may fail briefly. We’ll update soon.
```
Sam (oncall): internal triage checklist (quick):
- Confirm blast radius (ids, customers) ✅ (Maya collecting)
- Rollback test node -> observe error rate drop ✅
- Rollback remaining nodes -> monitor 2m windows -> escalate on regression
- Apply temporary concurrency cap: `EMB_WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENCY=6` -> reduces queue spikes
- Enable model fallback route for priority customers -> route to `embed-small-v1`
- Prepare postmortem skeleton and assign owner
Priya (SRE): helpful command snippets for oncall:
```bash
# tail recent errors for embeddings-workers
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=embeddings-worker --since=5m | grep -i timeout | tail -n 200
# check deployment age and image
kubectl -n prod get deploy embeddings-worker -o=jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image} {..status.replicas}'
```
Maya (Support): internal statuspage blurb (short):
```
Summary: Intermittent embedding request failures in eu-west-1 affecting a subset of customers (indexing/generation jobs).
Impact: Some requests return errors or time out; partial service degradation for embeddings in eu-west-1.
Current status: Mitigation in progress (rollback + traffic routing). ETA for broad recovery: ~30–45 minutes.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when there’s a major change.
```
Zoe (CS): adding a customer-facing expanded note for enterprise customers with SLA concerns: include “we will prioritize your jobs” and offer a 1:1 bridge if needed.
Sam (oncall): handoff note to next oncall (if still active at handover):
```
Handoff for incident-1965:
- Current status: rolling back embeddings-worker; error rate decreased on test node to ~3% from 8%
- Actions completed: rollback testing, concurrency cap applied to canary, fallback route configured for high-priority traffic
- Open tasks: finish cluster rollback, monitor 30m window, confirm statuspage updates, prepare postmortem owner
- Contacts: Priya (SRE), Maya (Support), Zoe (CS).
```
Maya (Support): note for agents — troubleshooting checklist when replying to customers:
- Ask for request ID / job ID / timestamp
- Check customer job logs in internal portal (link)
- Confirm region: eu-west-1? Recommend retry after 5 mins if transient
- Escalate to `CS-high` with tag `incident-1965` for enterprise customers
Priya (SRE): monitoring note: watch for error rate returning to baseline (<1%). If >4% after rollback complete, revert to safe-fallback and open immediate rollback RCA.
Sam (oncall): final: sending ACK macro to top 12 impacted customers now. keeping channel updated. :white_check_mark:
Maya (Support): posting macro to Zendesk and scheduling Intercom broadcast for affected segments once Sam confirms cluster stable.
incident-bot: Incident channel updated: #incident-1965 created and bridge set up at meet.redwood.com/incident-1965.
Sam (oncall): closing loop here for now, will post resolution and postmortem link in this thread once we have root cause. Thanks team. :pray:
